name: Recipe Steps
tagline: Hand-drawn outlines on cream, a step card and numbered dots that count you through any process.
description: Warm, illustrated how-to style for recipes, setup guides and any process with a handful of steps. Flat drawings with a soft brown ink outline on cream paper, a chunky red rounded title, a white step card ('STEP 3 OF 5') with a big value and a progress bar, numbered dots along the bottom that fill as you advance, and bouncy, elastic motion. The preview fills a glass layer by layer and ends on a celebratory finish card.

display.usage: Title 120px in red with a 4px ink stroke and a 6px soft-pink offset shadow; card quantity 104px, ingredient 50px, step labels 26–28px tracked 0.06–0.08em

body.usage: Subtitle 40px, card notes 30px, measurement tick labels 30px in muted brown

transitions: no scene cuts: one continuous illustrated set where only the main drawing, card and dots change
card content crossfades (out 0.15s up, in 0.25s from 16px below) with a 3% card bump on each step
props enter from the upper left, do their action, then leave the way they came
textAnimations: title letters rise from below at scale 2.2 with back.out, 0.04s stagger
card quantity and ingredient swap per step; progress bar scaleX fills over the step
step dot ring turns red and pops 1.25×, then fills red with a white check when the step ends
a tick label turns red when the growing element reaches it

rhythm.notes: Intro title 1.2s, then one step every 0.9–1.5s (pours get the longer slots), then a 1.5s finish card. Something always moves: the liquid surface scrolls its wave continuously.

guide:
- Look only: build the user's own subject in this visual language; don't reuse the example's scene.
- Cream #fbf6ec background with a faint dot grain (1px #3b2f2f dots at 7% on a 9px grid, 0.5 opacity). Every drawing is flat SVG with a 4–5px #3b2f2f round-joined outline and a flat light fill (#e3f1f1, #f6c3c4, #fffdf8, plus soft accents like #86b552 and #f0a93b), so it feels hand-drawn. Never use gradients or photos.
- Title is red #e5484d Baloo 2 800 at 120px with a 4px ink stroke and a 6px #f6c3c4 offset shadow; letters rise from below at scale 2.2 with back.out, 0.04s stagger. Subtitles and notes are Patrick Hand 30–40px in muted #6b5d55.
- One continuous illustrated set, no scene cuts: the main drawing sits centre-left (~360px wide) and changes in place step by step while the layout around it stays put.
- Motion is soft and physical: things fill or grow with power1.inOut, settle with an elastic.out(1, 0.3) wobble, drop in with bounce.out, pop with back.out(2). Props enter from the upper left, do their action, and leave the way they came. Keep one element always moving (e.g. a sine-wave surface or gentle sway).
- Optional motif: a white #fffdf8 step card at x≈1150 showing 'STEP N OF M' (red Baloo 2, tracked 0.06–0.08em), a big 104px quantity or value, a 50px label, a one-line note and a progress bar that fills over the step; content crossfades out 0.15s up and in 0.25s from 16px below with a 3% card bump.
- Optional motif: numbered dots along y≈950: grey #c9c0b4 outline = upcoming, red ring = current (pop 1.25×), red fill with white check = done; connectors fill red as you advance.
- Pacing: a 1.2s title, then one step every 0.9–1.5s (longer actions get longer slots), 4–6 steps in all, then a 1.5s finish card tilted -2.5° with back.out and red rays drawing on around the main drawing.
example: The preview makes an iced matcha latte: a hand-drawn glass fills layer by layer as jugs pour and ice drops in, while a step card and step dots count through the recipe to an 'ALL DONE!' card. Don't copy this scene unless asked.
